notes.title: 2 Gamemodes
notes.content:
Labyrinth escape contains 2 gamemodes:
- Find teleport in labyrinth (no timelimit)
- Time gamemode. Timelimit to pass level 

Also would like to hear more suggestion for community for different gamemodes
